en: A black‑and‑white rural landscape view showing a scattered village in a wide valley with low hills in the background. Traditional wooden farmhouses and barns are spread across open fields divided by fences. In the foreground there is a cluster of larger wooden buildings and a group of people sitting on the grass. At the bottom right, a caption is printed directly on the image.
